blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

faq.q: Can I build a second house on a Bradner farm property?
faq.a: Only within the ALC limits: one principal residence per parcel (maximum 500 m²), a secondary suite only inside that residence, and an additional small residence for farm use or another permitted use — maximum 90 m² on parcels of 40 ha or less, or 186 m² on parcels over 40 ha.

faq.q: Is Bradner in the Agricultural Land Reserve?
faq.a: Partly — Bradner is a rural agricultural community on Abbotsford's west side, with lands zoned A1 and A2 Agricultural under the City of Abbotsford Zoning Bylaw and part of the area in the ALR; whether a specific parcel is in the ALR must be confirmed for that parcel.

faq.q: Can a suite go in a barn or a detached building on ALR land?
faq.a: No — under the ALC housing rules a secondary suite is permitted only inside the principal residence; a detached second dwelling is the "additional residence," which is size-capped and tied to farm use or another permitted use.

Catchments are address-based in SD34. For the test address 5396 Bradner Road, the SD34 School Locator returns Bradner Elementary (K–5), Eugene Reimer Middle (6–8) and Rick Hansen Secondary (9–12) (SD34 School Locator, mybaragar.com, run 2026-11-01).
